newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: North and Central America port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: North and Central America port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

EL SALVADOR, July 14 - Acajutla - Nine vessels due of which 1 to discharge palm oil, 1 to discharge corn, 1 to discharge soda ash, 1 to discharge tallow, 1 to discharge/load containers, 1 to discharge steel products, 1 to discharge full containers, 1 to discharge bulk powder in pallets, 1 to discharge bulk fertiliser. Delays cannot be predicted. 3 Vessels loading at berth of which 1 wood, 1 bulk sugar, 1 empty containers. Discharging at berth, 1 corn, 1 fertiliser, 1 full container vessel. Waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 corn, 1 ammonium sulphate in bulk.

HONDURAS, July 14 - Puerto Cortes - Five vessels berthed of which 2 discharging/loading containers/generals, 1 discharging/loading containers/bananas, 1 discharging soya, 1 loading lumber. 1 vessel anchored to discharge/load containers/general. 20 Vessels due of which 1 passenger, 9 to discharge/load containers/generals, 6 to discharge/load containers/bananas, 1 to discharge/load generals, 1 to load lumber, 1 to discharge wheat, 1 to discharge fuel oil. Vessels berthed - 3 Discharging/loading containers, 1 discharging fertiliser, 1 discharging sbm/corn, 1 loading wood, 1 discharging vehicles/passengers. Vessels awaiting berth, 5 to discharge/load containers, 1 to discharge paper/load wood. Vessels due, 5 to discharge bananas, 9 to load/discharge containers, 1 to discharge bagged rice, 1 to discharge wheat, 1 to discharge urea.

MEXICO, July 15 - Tampico - Vessels in port, 2 steel coils, 3 general cargo, 2 minerals, 1 gasoline, 1 corn, 1 repair. Port working normally. Altamira - Vessels in port, 2 containers, 2 chemicals. Port working normally. Veracruz - Vessels in port, 3 sugar, 1 wood, 1 steel coils, 2 corn, 1 fertiliser, 3 grain, 2 container vessels. Port working normally. Manzanillo - Vessels in port, 2 cement, 2 steel coils, 2 containers, 2 general cargo, 3 fish flour, 1 oil tanker. Port working normally. Coatzacoalcos - Vessels in port, 7 oil tankers, 5 chemical, 1 repair. Port working normally.

PANAMA, July 14 - Cristobal, Balboa - Working normally. Panama Canal - Waterway operating at reduced capacity since 7/7 due to locks lanes outages at Miraflores and Gatun for major maintenance and improvement projects until 19/7. 43 Vessels due, 47 in queue, 16 booked, 27 scheduled. On 15/7 the projected 48 hour backlog has now reached 80 vessels. Delays to non-booked panamax vessels are now 4 days, and for non-booked small vessels, 3 days. This delay may diminish as the work on Gatun locks is completed 16/7 p.m. However, Miraflores locks repair will not be complete until 2359 hrs. 19/7. If ship arrivals are high, the backlog could increase further by the end of the week. If backlog reaches 90 vessels, the Panama Canal commission could invoke the triple booking fee rule.

UNITED STATES, July 14 - Baltimore, MD - Vessels operating in port, 5 bulkers, 8 container vessels, 4 ro-ro, 5 auto vessels, 2 tankers, 3 general cargo, 3 cable vessels on standby, 3 vessels in repair yard. 1 Bulker awaiting berth. Hampton Roads, VA - Seven general cargo/container vessels in pier operating, 3 bulkers in pier loading coal, 4 anchored waiting to load. 3 Bulkers loading of which 1 fertiliser, 1 woodpulp, 1 scrap metal. 1 Vessel in pier under repair, 1 vessel anchored carrying out exercises. Honolulu, HI - Harbour - 1 Container vessel berthed, 4 tugs and barges berthed, 1 tanker at anchorage. Barbers Point, HI - Vessels berthed, 1 tanker, 2 barges, 1 tanker at offport moorings.
